writing_observation: Identifies branch-level underdetermination in guided distillation and contrasts a working case with an asymmetric failure case. The remedy mirrors the diagnosed components, with claims explicitly conditioned on the setting; quantitative transfer effects are absent.

title: CodeNib: A Multi-View Data System for Serving Repository Context to Coding Agents
writing_observation: Connects fragmented repository tooling to lifecycle cost, then specifies reusable views and shared serving. The evidence is unusually disciplined: matched rebuilds, medians, a 63% valid subset, and paired token comparisons explicitly limit each efficiency claim.

title: CoRT: Counterfactual Replay for Token-Level Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization
writing_observation: A precise mismatch between rubric granularity and response-level credit motivates token weighting. Counterfactual likelihood is explicitly called a proxy, and unchanged reward plus matched baselines clarify the comparison; an average point gain and non-universal wording keep the result bounded.

title: HiFi-UMI: Learning Deployable Manipulation Policies from High-Fidelity UMI Data Alone
writing_observation: A sharply posed question challenges the need for robot-data anchoring, followed by hardware choices tied to fidelity. Mixed positive and negative backbone differences, task-specific success, and separate pretraining results expose tradeoffs and evidence scope rather than presenting a uniform win.

title: Metis: Memory Foundation Model
writing_observation: An external-versus-native memory gap leads to a two-part definition before the prototype architecture. The abstract carefully distinguishes frozen weights from changing memory state and specifies forward-only updates; evaluation is described broadly, while explicit strengths-and-limitations analysis signals a bounded research agenda.

title: DistillAlign: Coordinating Mode Covering and Mode Seeking in Autoregressive Video Distillation
writing_observation: Turns a training-stage mismatch into an evaluation problem before proposing the combined objective. Precision-versus-coverage distinctions make failure mechanisms legible; a smaller-teacher comparison sharpens the takeaway, although quality and diversity improvements lack effect sizes.

title: Mental World Modeling
writing_observation: Contrasts observable physical state with hidden beliefs and intentions, then formalizes a coupled predictive state. An inspectable training-free baseline operationalizes the framework. Eight models and multimodal scenarios specify scope, but 'essential' causal language needs the omitted quantitative and experimental details.

title: TurboVLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Model at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with <1 GB VRAM
writing_observation: Shows the old and proposed information pathways explicitly, turning architectural simplification into the central argument. Independent encoders and lightweight interaction explain the change. A named benchmark, success rate, parameter count, latency, memory, and exact GPU provide a tightly scoped efficiency result.

title: Qwen-UI-Agent Technical Report: Toward Next-Generation Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
writing_observation: Separates an ambitious real-world vision from concrete runtime, action-space, data, and long-horizon training designs. Numerous named benchmark scores and distinct mobile/computer/browser categories support the results, while broad reliability aspirations remain larger than those measured settings.

title: Frontis-MA1: Training an AI4AI Model towards Recursive Self-Improvement in Machine Learning Engineering
writing_observation: The abstract grounds an ambitious self-improvement goal in executable engineering tasks and four shared training/search operators. Hardware, time, memory limits, before–after scores, and held-out component swaps provide unusually explicit comparison conditions; the broader RSI framing remains an intended research direction.

title: AskChem: Claim-Centered Infrastructure for Chemistry Literature Synthesis
writing_observation: AskChem changes the retrieval unit from documents to sourced claims, making provenance part of the system definition. Its evaluation reports citation resolvability and density, which support traceability but should not be presented as complete evidence of scientific synthesis correctness.

title: PhiZero: A World Model Built Around Physical Language
writing_observation: Defines the intermediate representation early and uses a reason-then-render sequence to clarify its role. The human-language analogy supports motivation, but physical coherence and transfer claims are not accompanied by named benchmarks, scores, or concrete failure boundaries.

title: MerchantBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Long-Term Coherence in E-Commerce Operations
writing_observation: Defines long-term coherence before selecting a domain with delayed and interdependent feedback. Simulation length, source-record count, tools, model configurations, and runs establish scope; a numerical human-relative outcome states the remaining capability gap directly.

title: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
writing_observation: Connects persistent state to limitations of short static safety tasks, then specifies an evolving arena and attack policy. Scenario scale, median tool calls, pooled success rate, and complexity-dependent gains provide substantial empirical context and clear evaluation units.

title: DAPD: Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation
writing_observation: Names a memorable failure mode, explains it as training–inference information asymmetry, and maps two anchoring levels onto that diagnosis. Point gains across model sizes add specificity, but two different 4B averages require their evaluation contexts to be distinguished.

title: Deferred Exposure of Future Trajectories for Verifiable Reasoning in Autonomous Driving VLMs
writing_observation: Identifies future-trajectory exposure as a supervision shortcut, then explains why merely removing it creates another task difficulty. Candidate-based decisions and deferred verification form a targeted remedy; capability gains remain unquantified and limited to the proposed evaluation setting.

title: LongHorizon-Harness: Advancing Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Tasks
writing_observation: The abstract diagnoses context-coupled state and unreliable self-assessment, then reformulates execution around independently verified state. Role separation makes the mechanism operationally clear, and before–after scores across named benchmarks expose both large gains and persistently low absolute performance in one domain.

title: SwanTale: Unified Multi-Speaker Speech and Audio Generation for Instruct and Zero-Shot Tasks
writing_observation: A concrete production-use inventory motivates two explicitly distinguished task contracts. The abstract pairs a data pipeline with several modeling and training components, but the module-heavy middle weakens the central mechanism's prominence; closing superiority claims omit benchmark names and score magnitudes.

title: Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0: A Unified Multimodal Model for Scalable 3D Generation, Understanding, and Editing
writing_observation: Connects unified 3D modeling to scarce editing data, then specifies corpus composition and two complementary model components. Conditional structure preservation explains editing behavior; evaluation claims and component benefits are stated without numerical effects.

title: JoyAI-Video-Edit: Real-Time Open-Ended Video Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
writing_observation: Defines real-time editing through causality, bounded resources, fidelity, and consistency before introducing the model. Three distillation/adaptation components map to particular failure modes. Resolution, frame rate, and exact accelerator give concrete deployment evidence; quality comparisons remain unquantified in the abstract.

title: Recursive Synthesis for Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks
writing_observation: Defines the data bottleneck as maintaining consistency among instructions, environments, solutions, and verifiers. Recursive verified extension directly addresses that dependency. Cost, corpus size, difficulty trends, and downstream gains form layered evidence; extrapolating no ceiling beyond fifteen rounds needs qualification.

title: AgentOPSD: Recursive Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
writing_observation: AgentOPSD motivates sequential credit assignment and links turn aggregation to recursive belief updates. It states the absence of extra critics or rollouts, then uses two model scales and component ablations to support performance and mechanism claims.

title: On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision
writing_observation: U-OPSD defines the missing supervision assumption, describes consensus-based pseudo-solutions, and targets disagreeing completions. The abstract separates thinking from non-thinking modes and reports matched comparisons, while internal consistency should not be equated with independently verified correctness.

title: SimWAM: A Simple World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
writing_observation: SimWAM explains how future prediction provides training supervision while an attention constraint removes future generation at inference. It separates modular architecture, reward optimization, and transfer evidence, making latency claims depend on the actual deployed computation path.

title: DarwinX: Evolving Agent Harnesses Through Natural Selection
writing_observation: Locates the failure in path-dependent single-lineage improvement, then proposes population selection with preserved coverage and archived alternatives. Named benchmarks, exact gains, held-out evaluation, and transfer support the story. The final general-competence claim is stronger than any one benchmark result.

title: Ouroboros: A Self-Developing Frontier Coding Agent with Reviewed Core Evolution
writing_observation: Defines self-development through reviewed runtime changes and separates autonomous evolution from experience-driven repair. Benchmark snapshots, concrete scores, and a long-lived deployment provide distinct evidence types. The final separation of live evolution from frozen evaluation usefully addresses attribution and safety boundaries.

title: SWE-Bench ProMax: Benchmarking Agents on Large-Scale Multilingual Code Refactoring
writing_observation: SWE-Bench ProMax connects prior test-quality concerns to specific curation procedures and a refactoring setting. It reports languages and cross-file complexity before model results, making benchmark difficulty an operational property rather than merely a low resolve rate.

title: Macaron-V1: Towards Open Continual Learning with Self-Improvement and Mixture-of-LoRA
writing_observation: Organizes a sprawling system around adaptation and collaboration, with concrete model-harness and adapter mechanisms. The closing distinction between current validation and still-open compounding gains is especially useful, preventing continual-learning ambition from becoming an asserted result.

title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
writing_observation: Develops a threat model from an architectural compatibility claim, then organizes consequences into four categories. Concrete extraction counts make impact tangible, while responsible disclosure and mitigation close the arc; the abstract does not provide uncertainty or coverage limits for prevalence.

title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
writing_observation: BDH-CQ separates demonstration-driven memory updates from latent query computation and adds controlled interventions to a public benchmark. The reported pass@2 and computed cost define one operating point; the efficiency claim should remain tied to that evaluation setup.

title: Co-Evolution in Agentic Systems: Toward Self-Directed Evolution Beyond Human Design
writing_observation: Identifies static learning context as the limit of single-agent improvement and organizes a survey around progressively adaptive components. Agent-agent, agent-environment, and meta-level evolution provide the taxonomy. Evaluation and control challenges are acknowledged, with no new empirical performance claim.

title: Beyond Pixels: From Video Priors to 4D Worlds

title: ComBodied Agents: a New Paradigm of Human-Centric Agentic AI

Evaluation requirements are proposed rather than measured, so the abstract should be read as a framework argument.

writing_observation: Frames paper generation as evidence management rather than prose alone, then distinguishes judgment from checkable operations and planning from reporting. Eight topics, validity/editability rates, ablations, detection precision, cost, and runtime provide varied evidence; acceptance quality is not established.

writing_observation: Strong-to-weak scaffolding frames a parameter-free transfer question and then attributes gains to deterministic code, routing, and formatting. title: Scaling Automatic Research Agents via World Models
writing_observation: Derives the bottleneck from different scaling behavior of generation and execution, then introduces simulated execution with bias and noise corrections. Theoretical and empirical support are separated; speedup ranges and model sizes substantiate benefits, with held-out and embodied tests extending scope.

title: Alaya-EVOKE: From Linear-Scaling Supervision to Endless World
writing_observation: Frames persistent memory and low latency as conflicting requirements, then explains external state and a redesigned long-horizon teacher. Hardware, resolution, chunk duration, and generation time make efficiency interpretable; benchmark superiority remains qualitative.

title: Demystifying Agent Skills: Why They Work-Until They Don't
writing_observation: Moves beyond aggregate success by pairing controlled comparisons with coded trajectories and explicit denominators. It separates execution benefits from retrieval failures and reports stable downstream success despite identification degradation, making conflicting measurements informative rather than hiding them.

title: Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation
writing_observation: A direct question about supervision asymmetry leads to an elegant information-removal mechanism. Three experimentally framed design lessons include degradation and failure conditions; before–after scores, benchmark count, matched data, and a privileged-supervision comparison make the evidence unusually inspectable.

title: Can We Defend Against AI-Generated Video Attacks on Real-World Crisis Events? A Systematic Evaluation of Detectors, Generators and Social Dissemination
writing_observation: RA-Bench motivates crisis-video detection through domain and dissemination gaps, then structures evaluation around detectors, generation conditions, and human perception. Its negative generalization findings are substantive results, illustrating that benchmark value does not require proposing a winning model.

title: StateM: Reaching 95.3% Raw Accuracy, or a \$15 Frontier Run, on Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harness Scaling
writing_observation: Concrete execution failures motivate improvements around frozen models, followed by a dense sequence of benchmark, transfer, and cost comparisons. Separating raw accuracy, shared-task subsets, final-run usage, and total expenditure improves accounting clarity; structure-dependent transfer is an explicit closing boundary.

title: Learn What's Left, Not What's Mastered: Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization
writing_observation: Derives two failures of fixed reward scalarization, then aligns independent normalization and saturation discounting to them. Win counts, benchmark-specific gains, and maintained easier objectives make the outcome multidimensional rather than a single headline improvement.

title: Zetta ζ: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
writing_observation: Explains why post-episode reflection is too slow for physical control, then separates three update timescales around a frozen policy. Named benchmarks, success rates, and speedup quantify evidence. An explicit rollout-budget qualifier usefully bounds the state-of-the-art claim.

title: HarnessEval-W: Agentifying the Evaluation of Visual Worlds
writing_observation: Motivates inspectable evaluation reasoning, then explains adaptive decomposition, specialized agents, and evidence validation. Model and case counts bound the study; human alignment is asserted without agreement statistics, so transparency and correctness remain distinct questions.

title: Co-RL: Unsupervised Reasoning Emerges from Diverse Cohort in Multi-agent RL
writing_observation: Supervision scarcity motivates self-rewarding, whose collapse risk then motivates independent peers. Diversity is linked to correlated-error reduction, providing an explanatory hypothesis and design rationale; benchmark counts and gain ranges specify breadth, though gain units and supervision-matching details remain unclear.

title: Agentic ESOpt: Fine-Tuning Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Minimal GPU Requirements
writing_observation: The abstract converts long-horizon RL limitations into three enumerated advantages for evolution strategies, then explains the update procedure and perturbation schedule. A named model/task gain and wins across matched settings anchor evidence, but minimal-memory and scaling claims lack measured resource figures.

title: SemComp-Bench: Benchmarking Semantic Task Completion in Video Generation
writing_observation: SemComp-Bench explicitly defines success and excludes unnecessary intermediate-step or appearance requirements. It separates data curation, structured judge questions, and two outcome metrics, demonstrating how a new benchmark should state both inclusion criteria and the limits of its construct.

title: DART-SD: Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents
writing_observation: Explains why linear trajectory imitation can penalize valid alternative paths, then introduces graph-based recovery and localized supervision. The mechanism is detailed and aligned with the diagnosis, but named benchmarks and measured improvements are absent.

title: SemaPLC: A Project-Grounded, Verification-Gated Agent Harness for PLC Code Generation
writing_observation: Locates the gap in project integration and runtime verification, then defines completion through external checks. Task counts and layered results show why static scores miss failures; the strongest conclusion is anchored to observed executed-trace comparisons.

title: FACET: Preserving Source Intent and Executable State in Terminal Task Synthesis
writing_observation: Task-artifact inconsistency and lost source intent form two precise failure modes. The abstract explains how a repaired shared environment grounds instructions, solutions, and verification, linking mechanism to validity; named downstream evaluation and alternative constructions support the story without numerical effect sizes.

title: VGI-Bench: Probing Visual Intelligence in Video Generation Models
writing_observation: VGI-Bench motivates valid visual processes rather than plausible final frames and states feasibility as a design criterion. Its analysis extends beyond leaderboard accuracy to input sensitivity, transfer limits, and denoising failures, connecting benchmark design to diagnostic insight.

title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
writing_observation: The abstract links static environments to stale learning signals, then proposes a wrapper that preserves original verification. A black-box diagnosis-and-validation loop explains adaptation, while benchmark/domain counts, held-out gains, and step reductions give scope; maximum improvements do not establish typical effects.

title: Annotations as Rollouts: Efficient and Scalable Reinforcement Learning for Video MLLMs
writing_observation: Introduces an overlooked use of labels, then immediately identifies the naive implementation's advantage inversion and its correction. Training-time ratios, model ranges, latency, and task-specific metrics provide dense evidence, with respective prior-best comparators carefully distinguished from a single universal baseline.

title: Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work
writing_observation: The abstract first defines working capability, then pairs environment diversity with coordination training as complementary development axes. Operational details support the conceptual framing, but broad leading-band claims lack named benchmarks and numerical scores; local deployability is tied to a stated model size.

title: FrontierChallenge: Evaluating Scientific Workflow Completion
writing_observation: FrontierChallenge distinguishes the planned benchmark from the released evaluated subset and contrasts partial credit with complete deliverables. Completion claims in failed trajectories become an additional finding, showing why transparent denominators and end-to-end criteria matter.

title: Agentic Game Development as a Verifiable Trajectory Data Engine for Scaling World Models
writing_observation: Uses executable code as an analogy to motivate engine-verifiable spatial feedback, then defines the proposed human–engine reward combination. This is a paradigm argument rather than an empirical results abstract: no implementation study, benchmark, or measured gain is supplied.

title: VoiceMem: Streaming Dual-Brain Memory for Real-Time Interaction
writing_observation: Splits conversational memory into informational and emotional functions, then adds streaming access and training infrastructure. Retrieval depth, score gains, persona benchmarks, and latency make the claims concrete. Unequal retrieval budgets are disclosed, but full comparability and delay conditions need the paper.

title: VBVR-Pro: A Scalable and Verifiable Suite for Native Visual Reasoning
writing_observation: Defines the construct before organizing the contribution into task scale, verifiable rewards, and mechanism studies. External benchmarks and generator counts make scope explicit; modality-dependent findings and cautious probing language add boundaries despite mostly unquantified performance claims.

title: PAWBench: How Far Are We from Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?
writing_observation: Defines a distribution-level requirement before arguing that single-video plausibility cannot measure it. Repeated-rollout evaluation, scenario count, and system count make the diagnostic design explicit; the universal-within-sample negative finding is bounded by consistency across tested scenarios.

title: UrbanGround: From Local Perception to Spatial Agency in a Real-Scale City
writing_observation: The abstract opens with a capability-composition question rather than a generic benchmark announcement. Three progressively harder research questions organize the sandbox evaluation; specific failures and accumulated-error limits are central, although model identities, sample sizes, and quantitative results are absent.

title: Beyond Data Scaling: Representation-Centric Continued Pre-training for Vision-Language-Action Models
writing_observation: Frames the intervention under limited robot data and explicitly fixes downstream protocols. Benchmark success rates, an honest sixth-place ranking, and unseen-embodiment data comparisons give a balanced evidence narrative, while compute scale bounds the efficiency positioning.

title: Qwen-Drive-1.0: An Initial Step towards a Vision-Language Foundation Model for Autonomous Driving
writing_observation: The initial-step framing appropriately limits ambition before a detailed architecture and staged-training description. The perception head is explicitly a probe and inspectable interface, while several evaluation regimes clarify coverage; competence preservation and planning performance remain qualitative without numerical results.

title: StudentSim: Training LLM-based Student Simulators
writing_observation: Defines two competing simulator requirements and translates them into separately named metrics, preserving the tradeoff. Student counts, matched records, and a concrete domain comparison strengthen evidence; labeling tutor training a proof of concept appropriately limits that downstream implication.

title: Repo-To-Skill: Distilling GitHub Repositories Into AI4AI Skills
writing_observation: The abstract defines an operational-knowledge gap and distinguishes reusable from task-specific distillation. Library counts make the resource concrete, while explicitly fixed backbone, harness, and execution budget sharpen the comparison; large relative gains would be easier to interpret with absolute scores.

title: Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions
writing_observation: Motivates reusable local functions through recurring remote-inference costs, then clearly separates compile-time teachers from deployment. It reports a challenging subset and openly states higher compilation cost, making the quality–latency tradeoff more informative than a simple superiority claim.

title: NeoHorse-1: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement via Agentic Post-Training with Routing Harness
writing_observation: NeoHorse-1 turns a broad self-improvement ambition into a routing, validation, curriculum, and retraining loop. Size-specific benchmark averages anchor the evidence, while the initial-prototype qualification appropriately limits what these experiments establish about sustained recursive improvement.

title: NCP-ArchPreview Technical Report: Moving towards Latent Space Language Models through Next Concept Prediction
writing_observation: Defines concept prediction while explicitly retaining token generation, then explains quantized concepts and feedback. Training scale, token savings, matched-parameter controls, downstream deltas, and small adaptation overhead provide multiple concrete evidence layers for architecture and objective contributions.

title: Vidu S2: Real-Time Interactive, Editable, and Spatial Video Generation
writing_observation: Vidu S2 separates avatar generation and video editing into two concrete capabilities, then gives operational details such as dynamic references and 720p output. Its broad superiority claim would need task-specific metrics and latency measurements beyond this abstract.

title: ZGCM-1: A Fully Open and Extremely Efficient Foundation Model for Math and Agentic Search
writing_observation: Frames limited model capacity as a reason to combine internal reasoning with tools. Architecture, curriculum, and interaction-trace training explain the recipe. Context scale and time-to-loss speedup quantify efficiency; frontier-model competitiveness remains qualitative and task-suite bounded.

title: Atria Dawn: The Dawn of Agentic Superintelligence
writing_observation: Introduces an agentic research model and a verifiable training pipeline, then pairs sixteen-benchmark evaluation with a human-AI collaboration case study. Task and participant counts clarify the observational evidence. Human judgments of infeasibility are reported as ratings, not causal proof of productivity.

title: ClusterFuG: Clustering Fully connected Graphs by Multicut
writing_observation: ClusterFuG distinguishes complete-graph clustering from sparse multicuts and unweighted correlation clustering before introducing factorized costs. This makes storage and inference efficiency part of the method's rationale, with large-node experiments and application benchmarks serving different evidential roles.

title: Toward Large Kernel Models
writing_observation: The abstract moves from small-data competitiveness to a precise scalability obstacle: coupling model and dataset size. Decoupling motivates a named projected-SGD algorithm and multi-GPU implementation; the claimed scale advantage is clear conceptually but lacks concrete sizes or comparative measurements.

title: Comparison of meta-learners for estimating multi-valued treatment heterogeneous effects
writing_observation: Starts with the estimand and established tool class, then isolates the difficulty introduced by multiple treatment levels. Error-bound dependence connects theory to the proposed comparisons, while synthetic and semi-synthetic validation explicitly bounds empirical scope and acknowledges weaknesses.

title: BNN-DP: Robustness Certification of Bayesian Neural Networks via Dynamic Programming
writing_observation: States a precise certification task over a compact input set, then explains dynamic programming through a stochastic-system interpretation. Regression and classification delimit applicability; maximum-order improvements quantify tightness and efficiency without identifying typical-case gains.

title: Second-order regression models exhibit progressive sharpening to the edge of stability
writing_observation: Explains an observed optimization phenomenon that constant-kernel models cannot represent, motivating a minimally richer quadratic model. The abstract separates a proved two-dimensional result from higher-dimensional observations and presents broader applicability as a suggestion rather than an established theorem.

title: SemSup-XC: Semantic Supervision for Zero and Few-shot Extreme Classification
writing_observation: SemSup-XC defines the unseen-class challenge within extreme classification before linking semantic descriptions and hybrid matching to generalization. Separate zero-shot and one-shot gains clarify the evaluation regimes, while ablations distinguish the value of descriptions from architectural components.

title: Adaptive IMLE for Few-shot Pretraining-free Generative Modelling
writing_observation: A few-shot mode-coverage problem leads to an existing alternative and its restrictive theoretical assumption. title: Scaling Laws for Generative Mixed-Modal Language Models
writing_observation: Establishes experimental breadth with modality, model-size, and token ranges before explaining the interaction term in the scaling law. A larger speech–text validation separates model fitting from testing, though its final improvement is not numerically reported.

title: Hypothesis Transfer Learning with Surrogate Classification Losses: Generalization Bounds through Algorithmic Stability
writing_observation: Defines hypothesis transfer by its lack of source-data access, then narrows analysis to regularized binary classification. Algorithmic stability yields named statistical guarantees; assumptions and quantities establish contribution boundaries without requiring an empirical superiority narrative.

title: Constrained Causal Bayesian Optimization
writing_observation: States the optimization problem and known-graph assumption immediately, then gives a two-stage graph-reduction and constrained-search method. Surrogate variants explain how observational and interventional information combine. Synthetic and real graph experiments target convergence and feasibility, with no numerical tradeoff reported.

title: Explaining the effects of non-convergent MCMC in the training of Energy-Based Models
writing_observation: This abstract resolves an apparent sampling paradox by distinguishing transient dynamics from equilibrium modeling. It builds an explanatory sequence from general energy-based models to solvable cases and numerical demonstrations, allowing analytical and empirical evidence to play complementary roles.

title: Using Large Language Models to Simulate Multiple Humans and Replicate Human Subject Studies
writing_observation: The abstract defines a new evaluation construct by contrasting population simulation with impersonating one individual. title: Interventional Causal Representation Learning
writing_observation: Poses a precise question about interventional information, explains the geometric insight with an example, and separates perfect from imperfect intervention guarantees. The stated identification equivalences make theorem strength and its data-dependent boundary visible without relying on empirical wins.

title: Atari-5: Distilling the Arcade Learning Environment down to Five Games
writing_observation: Motivates benchmark reduction through evaluation cost and proposes representative subset selection. title: Towards credible visual model interpretation with path attribution
writing_observation: Identifies a tension between axiomatic guarantees and counter-intuitive explanations. A systematic investigation derives avoidance conditions and a game-theoretically consistent integration mechanism before presenting the method. Multiple evaluation dimensions support the claim, though dataset identities and improvement magnitudes are omitted.

title: Recasting Self-Attention with Holographic Reduced Representations
writing_observation: Hrrformer grounds its efficiency motivation in very long malware sequences and then supplies explicit time and space bounds. Near-leading accuracy is qualified separately from training speed, illustrating why computational complexity, epoch count, and wall-clock claims need distinct evidence.

title: A Simple Zero-shot Prompt Weighting Technique to Improve Prompt Ensembling in Text-Image Models
writing_observation: A practical prompt-engineering burden is sharpened into an explicit question with a no-label constraint. Bias diagnosis motivates scoring correction and weighted ensembling; comparator types and benchmark counts specify evaluation scope, while the optimization-free condition clarifies the operational advantage.

title: On the Privacy-Robustness-Utility Trilemma in Distributed Learning
writing_observation: Motivates a joint guarantee that separate literatures leave unresolved, then pairs lower- and upper-bound proof strategies. The threat model and aggregation mechanism supply specificity; tightness is presented as a matched analytical result rather than an empirical performance claim.

title: Robust and Scalable Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection
writing_observation: Leads with robustness and scalability, then links generalized Bayesian inference and score matching to closed-form updates. A speed factor supports computational relevance; the abstract's proof and exactness claims require their formal conditions from the paper.

title: Neural Wasserstein Gradient Flows for Discrepancies with Riesz Kernels
writing_observation: Starts from singular-measure behavior that prevents standard map-based treatment, making the technical obstacle explicit. Neural transport and velocity plans enable two numerical schemes. Analytic examples and convergence claims are separated from illustrative numerical results, clarifying theoretical versus empirical support.

title: Near-Optimal $Φ$-Regret Learning in Extensive-Form Games
writing_observation: This theory abstract states the game assumptions, improved regret rate, prior comparator, and equilibrium implication before its proof ingredients. Naming the settled open question establishes significance without importing an empirical-paper template that would obscure the mathematical contribution.

title: SGD with Large Step Sizes Learns Sparse Features
writing_observation: The abstract foregrounds observed training dynamics and enumerates two linked phenomena before deriving their regularization interpretation. Explicitly distinguishing empirical observations, simple-model theory, and qualitative stochastic arguments helps calibrate evidence; general deep-network implications are broader than the stated theoretical setting.

title: Neural Continuous-Discrete State Space Models for Irregularly-Sampled Time Series
writing_observation: Connects irregular observations to a continuous-state model and explains auxiliary variables through their inference role. Three dynamics parameterizations signal flexibility, while the final empirical statement names imputation and forecasting but leaves benchmark identities and gain sizes unspecified.

title: Exponential Smoothing for Off-Policy Learning
writing_observation: Defines off-policy learning, introduces smooth importance-weight regularization, and states a two-sided generalization guarantee without bounded weights. The conclusion explicitly identifies circumstances where the proposed regularization is unnecessary, preserving a useful negative boundary.

title: Polynomial Time and Private Learning of Unbounded Gaussian Mixture Models
writing_observation: Defines private mixture estimation and introduces a black-box reduction to existing non-private algorithms. Assumption removal and polynomial-time/sample-complexity guarantees supply the contribution evidence. An additional variation-distance lower bound is clearly identified as a separate theoretical result rather than an empirical claim.

title: Principled Acceleration of Iterative Numerical Methods Using Machine Learning
writing_observation: The paper motivates a modified training objective through a diagnosed mismatch between numerical acceleration and classical meta-learning. A deterioration result provides the reason for the change; applications then test its practical usefulness rather than carrying the entire novelty argument.

title: Prototype-Sample Relation Distillation: Towards Replay-Free Continual Learning
writing_observation: A practical restriction on retaining prior data motivates replay-free continual learning. Representation learning, evolving prototypes, and relational distillation form a coherent mechanism; distinguishing task- from class-incremental outcomes usefully bounds the strongest performance claim, although results are not quantified.

title: From Robustness to Privacy and Back
writing_observation: Positions the contribution against a specific transformation limitation, then states a black-box result with an explicit low-dimensional optimality boundary. Examples extend relevance, and the final pure-versus-approximate privacy distinction carefully qualifies which output-range benefit is possible.

title: SGD with AdaGrad Stepsizes: Full Adaptivity with High Probability to Unknown Parameters, Unbounded Gradients and Affine Variance
writing_observation: Identifies three limitations of existing analyses and states how the new theory removes them. Convexity, smoothness, noise structure, and probability guarantees delimit the contribution; the abstract offers theorem-level outcomes rather than empirical performance claims.

title: Adversarially Robust PAC Learnability of Real-Valued Functions
writing_observation: Poses a precise learnability question under explicit loss and perturbation assumptions. Finite complexity gives the positive result; convexity distinguishes proper from necessarily improper learning. A compression construction supplies the proof mechanism, and the abstract clearly separates its auxiliary theoretical contribution.

title: Infusing Lattice Symmetry Priors in Attention Mechanisms for Sample-Efficient Abstract Geometric Reasoning
writing_observation: LatFormer connects a geometric prior to attention-mask construction and then to sample efficiency. Its synthetic-task evidence is distinct from preliminary ARC and LARC observations, preserving a useful boundary between controlled mechanism tests and broader reasoning ambitions.

title: Learning to Initiate and Reason in Event-Driven Cascading Processes
writing_observation: Concrete intervention examples motivate a new supervised problem, after which observations, instructions, known dynamics, and desired counterfactual behavior are specified. The search mechanism follows naturally from that contract; application examples are broader than the physical-object testbed actually described.

title: On the convergence of the MLE as an estimator of the learning rate in the Exp3 algorithm
writing_observation: Begins with dependence and nonstationarity as reasons to doubt a familiar estimator, then presents a negative result followed by a conditional positive one. Constant versus decaying learning rates and prediction versus estimation errors make the boundaries unusually clear.

title: Dirichlet Diffusion Score Model for Biological Sequence Generation
writing_observation: Motivates biological sequence design through constrained discrete data and identifies a mismatch with continuous diffusion. A simplex-valued process supplies the bridge; Sudoku and promoter-sequence experiments illustrate applicability, while similarity to natural sequences does not establish biological function.

title: Naive imputation implicitly regularizes high-dimensional linear models
writing_observation: Begins with a practical paradox: biased naive imputation can predict well. A high-dimensional missing-completely-at-random setting makes the scope explicit, while a ridge connection explains the phenomenon. Error bounds and a stated dimensional regime carry the evidence, with experiments described as illustrations.

title: Half-Hop: A graph upsampling approach for slowing down message passing
writing_observation: Half-Hop introduces a concrete graph transformation before describing its consequences for message passing. The oversmoothing rationale, heterophily results, and augmentation extension give readers separate reasons to assess the mechanism, its strongest operating regime, and its reuse.

title: CLUTR: Curriculum Learning via Unsupervised Task Representation Learning
writing_observation: The abstract locates instability in jointly changing task distributions and policies, then explains a two-stage representation/curriculum solution. Named environments, a named UED baseline, separate generalization gains, and interaction savings make evidence concrete, though the very large ratios lack absolute endpoints.

title: Personalized Subgraph Federated Learning
writing_observation: Explains the privacy-constrained setting before distinguishing community heterogeneity from missing links. Each mechanism addresses a concrete information constraint, and the evaluation explicitly covers overlapping and non-overlapping subgraphs; six-dataset superiority is stated without numerical magnitude.

title: Efficient Self-supervised Learning with Contextualized Target Representations for Vision, Speech and Language
writing_observation: Identifies modality specificity and training cost, then explains three concrete efficiency changes. Named task–baseline pairs each include a time-saving factor; a separate accuracy-oriented setting explicitly shows that speed and quality can be traded.

title: Efficient preconditioned stochastic gradient descent for estimation in latent variable models
writing_observation: Motivates a new optimizer through inference difficulty and limitations of existing gradient/EM methods. Fisher-information preconditioning supplies the distinctive mechanism. General convergence claims are paired with two concrete simulation families, although the abstract's 'mild assumptions' require specification in the body.

title: Feed Two Birds with One Scone: Exploiting Wild Data for Both Out-of-Distribution Generalization and Detection
writing_observation: This abstract carefully distinguishes covariate-shift generalization from semantic-shift detection before proposing a shared margin constraint. Access to unlabeled wild data is a central experimental assumption, while comparisons with specialized methods assess whether the unified objective sacrifices either capability.

title: Answering Complex Logical Queries on Knowledge Graphs via Query Computation Tree Optimization
writing_observation: Two successive baseline limitations motivate an exact optimization method, and tree-encoded independence explains why the search becomes tractable. Dataset count, average improvement, and atom-level interpretation accuracy give multiple evidence anchors; the precise scope of the exactness guarantee remains implicit.

title: Implicit Graph Neural Networks: A Monotone Operator Viewpoint
writing_observation: Lists three obstacles and matches them to well-posedness analysis, orthogonal parameterization, and accelerated solving. This parallel structure clarifies multiple contributions, while node- and graph-level validation defines scope without quantifying the claimed accuracy and efficiency benefits.

title: Tensor Decompositions Meet Control Theory: Learning General Mixtures of Linear Dynamical Systems
writing_observation: Positions the method relative to prior mixture-system learning and motivates mixtures through richer subpopulation structure. Tensor decomposition relaxes separation and supports partial observation; the abstract explains the conceptual connection rather than reporting benchmark performance.

title: Block Subsampled Randomized Hadamard Transform for Nyström Approximation on Distributed Architectures
writing_observation: Introduces a structured random transform through its expected distributed-computing advantage. An embedding theorem and row-complexity comparison support approximation quality. Performance language remains prospective; the abstract distinguishes proved geometry from anticipated speed and implementation discussion.

title: Efficient Online Reinforcement Learning with Offline Data
writing_observation: The paper frames its contribution as making existing off-policy reinforcement learning use offline data effectively. Ablations justify minimal changes across data-quality regimes, and the reported improvement includes a compute qualification that makes the practical recommendation easier to assess.

title: On the Functional Similarity of Robust and Non-Robust Neural Representations
writing_observation: The abstract sets up a tension between functional similarity and adversarial robustness, then resolves it through metric- and layer-dependent findings. Reporting compatibility loss and recovery avoids a binary conclusion; the final interpretation is explicitly scoped to classification representations and framed as a suggestion.

title: Robust Budget Pacing with a Single Sample
writing_observation: Turns an industry procedure into a precise historical-sample question, states the auction and budget setting, and contrasts sample requirements with regret guarantees. Distinguishing optimal from near-optimal rates preserves the theoretical tradeoff while adding a noise-robustness boundary.

title: One Transformer Fits All Distributions in Multi-Modal Diffusion at Scale
writing_observation: Begins with a unified distribution-learning goal and derives modality-specific noise levels as the core insight. It enumerates supported generation directions and names metrics and comparators, but quantitative superiority is not expressed as numerical effects.

title: Optimizing the Collaboration Structure in Cross-Silo Federated Learning
writing_observation: Defines negative transfer as the collaboration failure and makes local-only training the meaningful reference point. Distribution distance and data quantity determine client coalitions. The mechanism explains who should collaborate; varied datasets and heterogeneity settings support breadth without numerical improvement magnitudes.
